name: zgeometry_model_process_clip_patch_node
description: zGeometry_Model::ProcessClipPatchNode clips model faces against a clip polygon, writes a generated display instance when clipping contributes geometry, and frees the temporary DI when no face touches the clip region.
known_limits: The smoke target covers null input, DI allocation failure, and the disjoint-face path that allocates then frees an untouched DI; contained/intersection output paths are covered through accepted callee functional targets and deferred to the coherent clip-patch cluster pass.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry model/clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46b6d0 validates null guards, DI allocation and failure return, mode initialization, face loop, invalid-vertex/report path, linear buffer acquisition, +90 X rotation, bounds-overlap gate, optional Weiler reset, ClipPointList mode 3 dispatch, switch handling for disjoint/intersection/contained cases, DI polygon emission, clip-output cleanup, untouched-DI free path, outDi write, polygon buffer cleanup, and final return.

The native process-clip-patch-node smoke verifies null input returns 1, allocation failure returns 0 without touching the caller output pointer, and a valid disjoint model face returns 1 with outDi cleared after freeing the temporary DI back to the pool.
